text: Added the `@yolo-twice/pele-markdown` markdown-it plugin (`renderMermaid`, 2 bun tests pass), a VitePress site where all four mermaid diagrams render to inline pele SVG with no `pele-error`, and a 9-slide Slidev deck built via `bun node_modules/@slidev/cli/bin/slidev.mjs` because Slidev 53 fails on Node 20.12. Wrote `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, but `gh api -X POST repos/bar9/yolo-twice/pages` returned 404 because `culmat` has write rather than admin, so the repo owner must enable Pages before the deploy can succeed. Nothing was committed; the only README change is a Website and pitch-deck link line under the title.
